newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: U.S. corn major net sales activity in the week ended Oct 3 reported by exporters for the following purchasing countries, in tonnes:
A-Net sales to Mexico reflects new sales of 166,700 tonnes, destination changes of 30,000 tonnes, and foreign purchases and cancellations of 23,300 tonnes.
B-Net sales to Taiwan reflects new sales of 173,700 tonnes and foreign purchases and cancellations of 56,600 tonnes.
Total net sales of 792,400 tonnes were 42 percent higher than the previous week.
Exports of 728,600 tonnes were 5 percent above the previous week, and 38 percent higher than the four-week average.
Primary export destinations: Japan (210,500), Mexico (130,900), Taiwan (111,300), S Korea (52,400) and Malaysia (51,000).
